_comment: relatedComponents must contain Drive Chain / CVT. That label does not exist in the car vocabulary, so an extractor that has not been told this is a motorcycle cannot return it, and the old behaviour - answering Transmission - now scores zero rather than being silently dropped downstream.
AC System must never appear. A motorcycle does not have one.

SHOP TOWEL / CONTACT CLEANER is MATERIAL: consumed doing the work, not fitted to the bike. DISPOSAL FEE is FEE. Engine oil is a PART because it is fitted and leaves with the vehicle, which is the same reason a filter is a part.
The eight amounts sum to 2450.00, matching the printed total exactly.
